il-immediate-seal.mandatoryOfficialFormHandoffsNote: None. The mandatory statewide adult suite expressly does not govern this track — the review records the suite as governing Tracks A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, J and stage 2 of K, and not this one. packetSet.components carries no officialFormId on any of the three components. Whether any Illinois court publishes a LOCAL form for § 5.2(g) is unknown and is an open release blocker; if one is found it would replace the constructed title and caption, but there is no form to hand off today.
openReleaseBlockers: No verified statewide form covers the § 5.2(g) same-day mechanism and the local-form override is unverified.

unmanifestedFilesOnDisk.note: Recorded by lane-C1 audit, not by the build job. These three files exist under this track directory but appear in no filesWritten list. Quarantined pending review; nothing downstream should treat these as the track's output.
